summary: Inbound pallet staging and temporary badge request for contracted warehouse setup
description:
Issue summary:
Customer: internal contractor (3rd-party AV integrator) arriving Tuesday 2026-03-17 with a 6-pallet delivery that contains AV racks and monitors. Delivery ETA 09:30 to Redwood contracted warehouse (eu-west). Request: schedule inbound pallet staging, assign temp badge for 2 contractors for the day window 08:30–17:00, ensure customs-related paperwork is received and labelled, and coordinate fork-lift access and pallet placement for secure holding.

Impact:
- If not staged correctly, hardware cannot be accepted by on-site technician, leading to missed install window and potential SLA breach with partner.
- Risk of unauthorized access if temporary badges are not restricted to the staging area.

Environment:
- Warehouse: Redwood contracted fulfillment partner (eu-west).
- Shipping: international palletized freight (commercial invoice attached).
- Parties: AV integrator (Contractor: AxisInstall Ltd.), Redwood on-site tech (Gloria Chen).

Request details / Acceptance criteria:
1) Confirm pallet arrival with carrier (DHL Freight) and update tracking.
2) Reserve staging bay B3 from 08:00–18:00 on 2026-03-17 and schedule forklift crew.
3) Issue two temporary day badges scoped to ‘warehouse-staging’ only (no building floor access) to contractor names: Tomasz Kowalski, Marta Nowak. Badges to expire 18:00 same day.
4) Verify commercial invoice and customs paperwork received by warehouse operations; notify SRE/Asset Mgmt for serial recording.
5) Photograph pallet labels and upload to ticket thread before handoff.

Steps already taken:
- Reporter emailed carrier (DHL) on 2026-03-09 and received provisional ETA.
- Asset manager confirmed AV rack serial prefixes are on the onboarding list.

Attachments:
- commercial_invoice_AXISINSTALL_20260305.pdf (uploaded to shared drive)
- initial_tracking_dhl_834155.pdf

Notes on constraints:
- Warehouse enforces PPE for any external contractors; contractor insurance certificate must be on file prior to badge issuance.
- Customs hold windows may require extra 2–4 hours clearance on arrival day.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Jordan Riley: Assigned. Reaching out to warehouse ops to confirm staging bay availability and forklift schedule.
2026-03-10 10:03 - Warehouse Ops (P. Müller): B3 is available provisionally; will confirm once carrier provides final ETA (we need 24h notice). Please upload insurance cert for external contractors.

2026-03-10 11:20 - Evelyn Park: Uploaded contractor insurance (AxisInstall_insurance_2026.pdf) and commercial invoice link in description. Carrier tracking updated: ETA still 2026-03-17 09:30; shipment on international hold-code 'C02' possible (customs check).

2026-03-11 08:45 - Jordan Riley: Requested temporary badge creation from Access Control. Provided contractor names and access scope. Pending proof of identity (passport scans) from contractor; requested by Access Control.
investigation_notes: Confirmed with Asset Management that AV racks require serial capture on arrival — added to asset intake checklist.
Carrier note indicates likely customs inspection; recommend buffer time for staging and notify installation team to shift onsite start to 11:00 tentatively.
Access Control flagged that our badge system requires contractor ID upload 48h before badge activation; exception possible with on-site security escort — awaiting approval from Security Manager.
resolution: Pending. Next steps: (1) Access Control to confirm whether security escort can be used as interim measure if passport scans are delayed; (2) Warehouse Ops to confirm final ETA 24h prior; (3) On 2026-03-16 morning Jordan to re-verify staging bay and forklift crew and post photographic evidence of pallet labels to this ticket. Target to close by 2026-03-17 end of day after successful handoff.
